description: Initialize Release 1261 prospective propositions, preserve valid schema-8 lived-feeling history, and initialize only the state tails that genuinely postdate each older schema.

replacements.old:
<ROUTINE MARA-ENSURE ()
    ;"Only schemas older than Release 1260 predate lived-feeling state. Pin this comparison to schema 8 rather than MARA-SCHEMA so a later release can advance the current schema without erasing valid Release 1260 history."
    <COND (<L? <GET ,MARA-STATE 0> ,MARA-LIVED-FEELING-SCHEMA>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-KNOWN-RISK-INJURY 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-AIDED-RECKLESS-INJURY 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-RECKLESSNESS-ANGER 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-FEAR-REVEALED 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-INTENTIONAL-HARM 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-HARM-BETRAYAL 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-RUPTURE-OPEN 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-APOLOGY-ACKNOWLEDGED 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-BOUNDARY-RESPECTED 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-REPAIR-EVIDENCE 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-RUPTURE-REPAIRED 0>)>
    <COND (<EQUAL? <GET ,MARA-STATE 0> 7>
replacements.new:
<ROUTINE MARA-ENSURE ()
    ;"Only schemas older than Release 1261 predate prospective anticipation. Pin this guard to schema 9 so a later release can advance MARA-SCHEMA without erasing valid Release 1261 history."
    <COND (<L? <GET ,MARA-STATE 0> ,MARA-ANTICIPATION-SCHEMA>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-ANTICIPATED-KNOWN-RISK 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-PROTECTIVE-INITIATIVE 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-WORRY-SPOKEN 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-WARNING-HEEDED 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-WARNING-OVERRIDDEN 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-RELIEF-AFTER-HEEDED 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-PROTECTIVE-PREPARATION 0>)>
    ;"Only schemas older than Release 1260 predate lived-feeling state. The fixed schema-8 boundary preserves real rupture/repair history when a schema-8 save advances to 9."
    <COND (<L? <GET ,MARA-STATE 0> ,MARA-LIVED-FEELING-SCHEMA>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-KNOWN-RISK-INJURY 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-AIDED-RECKLESS-INJURY 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-RECKLESSNESS-ANGER 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-FEAR-REVEALED 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-INTENTIONAL-HARM 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-HARM-BETRAYAL 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-RUPTURE-OPEN 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-APOLOGY-ACKNOWLEDGED 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-BOUNDARY-RESPECTED 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-REPAIR-EVIDENCE 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-RUPTURE-REPAIRED 0>)>
    <COND (<EQUAL? <GET ,MARA-STATE 0> ,MARA-PREVIOUS-SCHEMA>
           ;"Release 1260 schema-8 saves retain lived feeling, rupture, repair, capability, and causal biography. Only Release 1261 prospective propositions begin empty."
           <PUT ,MARA-STATE 0 ,MARA-SCHEMA>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-ANTICIPATED-KNOWN-RISK 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-PROTECTIVE-INITIATIVE 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-WORRY-SPOKEN 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-WARNING-HEEDED 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-WARNING-OVERRIDDEN 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-RELIEF-AFTER-HEEDED 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-PROTECTIVE-PREPARATION 0>)>
    <COND (<EQUAL? <GET ,MARA-STATE 0> 7>
